bullets: reconocer y usar el subjuntivo inglés (I insist that he be present)
usar should después de palabras de sorpresa e importancia
usar el presente histórico y el futuro en el pasado en las narraciones
conocer las expresiones fijas formales con subjuntivo

blocks.text: Después de verbos y expresiones de exigencia, recomendación y propuesta, el inglés formal usa el verbo sin nada para todas las personas, también con he, she e it, e incluso con be. Es un subjuntivo, pero mucho más sencillo que el español: una sola forma, sin tiempos.

head: Después de
Ejemplo
Ojo
rows: They insisted that he leave immediately.
sin -s y sin pasado, aunque el español diga 'que se fuera'
I recommend that she see a specialist.
It is essential that everyone be on time.
We suggest that he not travel alone.
not delante del verbo, sin do

blocks.title: En británico: a menudo should
blocks.text: En inglés británico, en lugar del subjuntivo también se oye mucho should: I suggest that he should leave. O simplemente la forma normal: I suggest that he leaves. Las tres son correctas; el subjuntivo es la más formal. Lo que nunca vale es copiar el tiempo del español: insistieron en que se fuera = they insisted that he leave, nunca that he left.
2. should después de la sorpresa y la importancia

Después de expresiones como it's strange / odd / surprising / a pity that el inglés usa a menudo should para mostrar sorpresa o emoción, donde el español usa el subjuntivo: It's strange that she should say that. (Qué raro que diga eso.) It's a pity that you should have to leave so soon. (Es una pena que tengas que irte tan pronto.)
3. Los tiempos en las narraciones y las noticias

head: Uso
Ejemplo
Efecto
rows: So I'm walking home, and this man comes up to me ...
He was to become the greatest painter of his age.
She would later describe it as her happiest year.

blocks.text: Después de it's time, I'd rather, as if, suppose, what if, el pasado se refiere al presente o al futuro, como el imperfecto de subjuntivo español: Suppose we took the train instead? (¿Y si cogiéramos el tren?) What if they found out? (¿Y si se enteraran?)

rows: I insist that he leaves at once.
I insist that he leave at once.
It is vital that everyone is there.
It is vital that everyone be there.
We suggest that he doesn't travel alone.
We suggest that he not travel alone.
Be it as it may, we will continue.
Be that as it may, we will continue.
Expresión fija: Be that as it may.
Suppose we take the train instead? (muy hipotético)
Suppose we took the train instead?
El pasado lo hace más prudente.

blocks.text: Completa con la forma correcta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: The doctor recommended that she ______ more rest.
items.full: The doctor recommended that she take more rest.

items.q: It is essential that the contract ______ signed today.
items.full: It is essential that the contract be signed today.

items.q: They demanded that he ______ the money back.
items.full: They demanded that he pay the money back.

items.q: We suggest that he ______ drive at night.
items.full: We suggest that he not drive at night.

items.q: ______ that as it may, we must continue.
items.full: Be that as it may, we must continue.

items.q: Come what ______, I will finish this book.
items.full: Come what may, I will finish this book.

items.q: It's odd that he ______ say such a thing.
items.full: It's odd that he should say such a thing.

items.q: She was ______ become one of the greatest writers of her time.
items.full: She was to become one of the greatest writers of her time.

items.q: What if they ______ out the truth?
items.full: What if they found out the truth?

items.q: If need ______, we can work at the weekend.
items.full: If need be, we can work at the weekend.

items.a: Be that as it may, we will continue.

items.q: Es esencial que todo el mundo llegue puntual. (formal)
items.a: It is essential that everyone be on time.

items.q: Si hace falta, podemos trabajar mañana.
items.a: If need be, we can work tomorrow.

items.q: Pase lo que pase, me quedo.
items.a: Come what may, I will stay.
